units.source: This is another table with expected {#1}attributes{/#1} scores. The last column is a custom made rating that shows how much more points a Background gets from average scores (Apprentice). Every attribute is accounted for and weighed according to its level-up range, {#2}the sum of each ([attribute average difference from Apprentice] ÷ [level-up range at 0 stars] ÷ [3, the number of upgrades per level-up]), rounded to 2 decimal places.{/#2} Thus, it represents roughly the number of attribute level-ups better that a Background is, compared to Apprentice. {#3}To see another version of the "Rating" column, refer to {#4}the previous page version{/#4}.{/#3}
units.zh: 下表列出各背景的预期{#1}属性{/#1}。最后一列是自定义评分，衡量该背景相较于基准背景（学徒）的平均属性优势。计算时纳入全部属性，并按各属性的升级增幅加权：{#2}将每项属性的［平均值与学徒的差］÷［0 星时的升级增幅］÷［3，即每次升级可提升的属性数］相加，结果保留 2 位小数。{/#2}因此，这个评分大致表示该背景相较学徒多出了多少次升级的属性收益。{#3}如需查看另一种“评分”算法，请参阅{#4}此页的旧版本{/#4}。{/#3}

units.source: The item tables contain in-game possible values (minima and maxima if applicable) extrapolated from the game scripts. Hovering over icons will show what they represent. Clicking on the items icons will open up specific pages. The weapons name could not fit into the tables (inherent width limitations) but was added over their durability values as an invisible overlay so they can be searched (Ctrl + F shortcut); when searching for a named weapon simply input the weapon type and omit the "named" word, e.g.: to successfully find the Named Battle Whip, the search query input needs to start from the word "battle". Sorting triggers for columns with weapon/armor parameters are placed in the corresponding column cells in a row below (with a golden arrow). {#1}(NOTICE: most of the individual named weapons pages have not been updated (primarily the shield damage stat is lower rather than being x1.5-2)){/#1}
units.zh: 下列表格依据游戏脚本整理了物品在游戏中可能出现的属性值，适用时列出最低和最高数值。将鼠标停在图标上可查看含义，点击物品图标可打开对应词条。由于表格宽度有限，武器名称以隐藏文字保留在耐久单元格中，便于使用Ctrl + F搜索。中文模式可按中文武器名称搜索，例如“战鞭”；英文模式下则省略“Named”，例如Named Battle Whip可从“battle”开始查找。原站说明中的武器和护甲排序入口位于对应列下方带箭头的单元格中；本站这类多层表头表格暂不支持排序。{#1}注意：多数单独的名贵武器词条尚未更新，主要是破盾伤害偏低，没有按x1.5-2的范围调整。{/#1}
